```{r setup}
#| output: false
# Set working directory to project root if rendering from 09_reporting/
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Run the full pipeline (builds all objects in this session)
# capture.output suppresses cat() log messages from leaking into the HTML
invisible(capture.output(source("run_pipeline_phase01.R")))

# Cache key pipeline objects so deep dive renders don't re-run the pipeline
pipeline_cache_objects <- c(
  "target_date", "target_season", "team_ids",
  "game_context", "lineup_context", "starter_matchup", "bullpen_grid",
  "offense_master_season", "player_career_offense", "player_career_pitching",
  "defense_master_season", "lineup_context_splits", "starter_splits"
)
pipeline_cache <- mget(
  pipeline_cache_objects[pipeline_cache_objects %in% ls()],
  envir = .GlobalEnv
)
saveRDS(pipeline_cache, "data/pipeline_cache.rds")

# Load report helpers
source("09_reporting/_report_helpers.R")
```

```{r report-date}
#| output: asis

# Determine which seasons stats are drawn from
mlb_stats_season <- if (exists("player_season_mlb_offense") && nrow(player_season_mlb_offense) > 0)
  unique(player_season_mlb_offense$season)[1] else NA

fg_stats_season  <- if (exists("player_season_fg_offense") && nrow(player_season_fg_offense) > 0)
  unique(player_season_fg_offense$season)[1] else NA

stats_note <- if (!is.na(mlb_stats_season) && !is.na(fg_stats_season) &&
                  mlb_stats_season != fg_stats_season) {
  paste0(" *(MLB stats: ", mlb_stats_season,
         " · FanGraphs stats: ", fg_stats_season, ")*")
} else if (!is.na(mlb_stats_season)) {
  paste0(" *(", mlb_stats_season, " season stats)*")
} else ""

cat(paste0(
  "> **", format(target_date, "%A, %B %d, %Y"), "** — ",
  nrow(game_context), " games", stats_note
))
```

```{r game-summary}
#| output: asis

summary_date_str <- tryCatch(
  as.character(target_date),
  error = function(e) as.character(Sys.Date())
)

summary_rows <- game_context %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    team_ids %>% dplyr::select(mlbam_team_id, away_abbr = team_abbr),
    by = c("away_team_id" = "mlbam_team_id")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    team_ids %>% dplyr::select(mlbam_team_id, home_abbr = team_abbr),
    by = c("home_team_id" = "mlbam_team_id")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    away_abbr     = dplyr::coalesce(away_abbr, as.character(away_team_id)),
    home_abbr     = dplyr::coalesce(home_abbr, as.character(home_team_id)),
    deepdive_file = paste0("deepdive_", summary_date_str, "_",
                           away_abbr, "_", home_abbr, ".html"),
    away_sp       = dplyr::coalesce(away_pitcher_name, "TBD"),
    home_sp       = dplyr::coalesce(home_pitcher_name, "TBD"),
    time_flag     = dplyr::case_when(
      tolower(day_night) == "day"   ~ "Day",
      tolower(day_night) == "night" ~ "Night",
      TRUE                          ~ "—"
    ),
    game_flag     = dplyr::case_when(
      isTRUE(is_division_game) ~ " &middot; <em>Div</em>",
      isTRUE(is_interleague)   ~ " &middot; <em>IL</em>",
      TRUE                     ~ ""
    )
  )

# Use seq_len row indexing — apply() coerces to matrix and drops rows
rows_html <- paste0(
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(summary_rows)), function(i) {
    r <- summary_rows[i, ]
    paste0(
      '<tr>',
      '<td style="white-space:nowrap; font-weight:600; padding:5px 10px;">',
        r$away_team_name, ' <span style="color:#888;">@</span> ', r$home_team_name,
        r$game_flag,
      '</td>',
      '<td style="white-space:nowrap; color:#555; font-size:13px; padding:5px 10px;">',
        r$away_sp, ' <span style="color:#bbb;">vs</span> ', r$home_sp,
      '</td>',
      '<td style="white-space:nowrap; color:#555; font-size:13px; padding:5px 10px;">',
        r$venue_name,
      '</td>',
      '<td style="font-size:12px; color:#777; text-align:center; padding:5px 8px;">',
        r$time_flag,
      '</td>',
      '<td style="text-align:center; padding:5px 8px;">',
        '<a href="', r$deepdive_file, '" style="font-size:12px; font-weight:600; ',
        'background:#1a73e8; color:white; padding:2px 9px; border-radius:3px; ',
        'text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap;">Deep Dive</a>',
      '</td>',
      '</tr>'
    )
  }, character(1)),
  collapse = "\n"
)

cat(paste0(
  '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:1.5rem; font-size:14px;">',
  '<thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6; color:#444;">',
  '<th style="text-align:left; padding:5px 10px;">Matchup</th>',
  '<th style="text-align:left; padding:5px 10px;">Probable SPs</th>',
  '<th style="text-align:left; padding:5px 10px;">Venue</th>',
  '<th style="text-align:center; padding:5px 8px;">D/N</th>',
  '<th style="padding:5px 8px;"></th>',
  '</tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>'
))
```

```{r games}
#| output: asis

report_date_str <- tryCatch(
  as.character(target_date),
  error = function(e) as.character(Sys.Date())
)

# Build game → deep dive filename lookup
game_links <- game_context %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    team_ids %>% dplyr::select(mlbam_team_id, away_abbr = team_abbr),
    by = c("away_team_id" = "mlbam_team_id")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    team_ids %>% dplyr::select(mlbam_team_id, home_abbr = team_abbr),
    by = c("home_team_id" = "mlbam_team_id")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    away_abbr   = dplyr::coalesce(away_abbr, as.character(away_team_id)),
    home_abbr   = dplyr::coalesce(home_abbr, as.character(home_team_id)),
    deepdive_file = paste0("deepdive_", report_date_str, "_",
                           away_abbr, "_", home_abbr, ".html")
  )

# knit_child() ensures each ## heading is processed as a top-level
# document section so pandoc's TOC builder captures all games.
# HTML is pre-built in the parent env; child text stays minimal.
game_sections <- lapply(game_context$game_pk, function(gpk) {

  game    <- game_context %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk)
  matchup <- paste0(game$away_team_name, " @ ", game$home_team_name)
  dd_file <- game_links %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk) %>% dplyr::pull(deepdive_file)

  # Pre-build all HTML in the parent env to keep child template simple
  btn_html <- paste0(
    '<p style="margin-top:-8px; margin-bottom:12px;">',
    '<a href="', dd_file, '" style="font-size:13px; font-weight:600; ',
    'background:#1a73e8; color:white; padding:4px 12px; ',
    'border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none;">',
    '&#128269; Full Deep Dive</a></p>'
  )
  game_hdr_html  <- gt::as_raw_html(make_game_header_gt(gpk))
  starters_html  <- gt::as_raw_html(make_starter_gt(gpk))
  lineup_a_html  <- gt::as_raw_html(make_lineup_gt(gpk, "away"))
  lineup_h_html  <- gt::as_raw_html(make_lineup_gt(gpk, "home"))
  bullpen_a_html <- gt::as_raw_html(make_bullpen_gt(gpk, "away"))
  bullpen_h_html <- gt::as_raw_html(make_bullpen_gt(gpk, "home"))
  legend_html <- paste0(
    '<p style="font-size:12px; margin-bottom:6px;">',
    '<span style="background:#27ae60;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Fresh</span> &nbsp;',
    '<span style="background:#a9dfbf;color:#1a5276;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Available</span> &nbsp;',
    '<span style="background:#f39c12;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Limited</span> &nbsp;',
    '<span style="background:#e74c3c;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Unavailable</span> &nbsp;',
    '<span style="background:#d5d8dc;color:#7f8c8d;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Injured</span>',
    '</p>'
  )

  knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(
      "## `r matchup`",
      "",
      "```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}",
      "cat(btn_html, '\n\n')",
      "cat(game_hdr_html, '\n\n')",
      "cat('### Starting Pitchers\n\n')",
      "cat(starters_html, '\n\n')",
      "cat('### Lineups\n\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-start;\">\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"flex:1; min-width:320px;\">\n')",
      "cat(lineup_a_html, '\n</div>\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"flex:1; min-width:320px;\">\n')",
      "cat(lineup_h_html, '\n</div>\n')",
      "cat('</div>\n\n')",
      "cat('### Bullpen\n\n')",
      "cat(legend_html, '\n\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-start;\">\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"flex:1; min-width:340px;\">\n')",
      "cat(bullpen_a_html, '\n</div>\n')",
      "cat('<div style=\"flex:1; min-width:340px;\">\n')",
      "cat(bullpen_h_html, '\n</div>\n')",
      "cat('</div>\n\n')",
      "cat('<hr style=\"border:none; border-top:2px solid #dee2e6; margin:2rem 0;\">\n\n')",
      "```"
    ),
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
})

cat(unlist(game_sections), sep = "\n")
```
